assessments.rationale: Defer. Sales and collections improved, but earnings/margins declined and the current close offers less upside to resistance than downside to confirmed support. This developer must not be valued against banks merely because TradingView groups it under Finance.
assessments.fundamentals: H1 2026 revenue EGP 5.135bn rose 7.2%, but net profit EGP 1.027bn fell 19.9%. Deliveries rose to 1,200 and net cash collections to EGP 9.9bn; debt about EGP 7.0bn was nearly offset by cash/short-term investments, leaving only EGP 163.3m net cash. Different project mix and deferred co-development recognition depressed margins [results]. Backlog is not present cash or profit. The presentation describes land-portion revenue recognition at sale and remainder at delivery [presentation]; discounting collections, cost-to-complete, cancellation rates and revenue recognition matter. TradingView P/E 5.47/PB 1.28 are provisional valuation inputs; screen revenue growth is TTM, not H1 growth. No independent NAV/DCF has been built.

H1 disclosures describe new commercial projects and a buyback authorization; authorization does not prove completed purchases [results]. The share-information page records a 4.17% distribution on 9 March and EGP 0.15 cash dividend on 24 May 2026 [owners]. These must be reconciled to chart split adjustments before interpreting long-horizon price momentum as shareholder return.

assessments.entryConditions: No entry now with the distant structural stop. Monitor for a new higher low above 7.50, which requires future bars to confirm, or a well-defined support reversal nearer 6.8–7.2. Recalculate risk to 8.88 before considering a swing. A break above 8.95 requires a fresh target rationale; do not substitute an arbitrary percentage target. Verify current ownership/action ledger and results updates first. At the reference close 7.86, an illustrative stop 6.57 and nearest-resistance target 8.88 imply EGP 1.29 per-share downside (16.41%) versus EGP 1.02 upside (12.98%), gross reward/risk 0.79. A hypothetical 0.50% round-trip cost scenario yields EGP 1.3293 loss and 0.74 reward/risk. Costs are a stress assumption, not known broker charges. This is diagnostic math, not an approved entry or guaranteed loss cap.
